messages:
Ravi: Need a compact benchmark messaging pack for launch focused on latency vs dollars. Deliverables: 3 chart concepts, one-line headline each, and inbound routing rules (self-serve vs sales).
Marcy: I'll do chart sketches. Ideas: 1) latency by sequence-length bins with $/1M overlay, 2) workload view (chat vs batch vs embed), 3) optimization waterfall showing cumulative $ savings.
Leah: Add a small decision card: when to choose Dedicated (thresholds: tokens/day, p95 latency). SDRs need quick guidance.
Omar: Routing: trial users >100k tokens/day or company on enterprise list -> tag and send to sales. Webinar attendees who watch >50% get SDR follow-up.
pipeline-bot: (automated) Creating workflow "launch-bench-qualify"; will post CRM events when rules match.
Ravi: Draft headlines: A) "Sequence length: where latency becomes cost" B) "Chat vs batch: compare per-million token economics" C) "Optimization waterfall: stacking batching, caching, quantization"
Marcy: Chart specs: A bins 0-64,65-256,257-1024; primary y=ms/token; secondary y=$/1M tokens. B grouped bars for workloads with base and quantized variants. C stacked waterfall with % savings annotations.
Leah: Make charts colorblind safe and add sample prompt per bin. Include a footnote with baseline model and hardware.
Ravi: A/B plan: Variant 1 = engineer-centric (configs + numbers); Variant 2 = outcome-centric (customer scenarios + CTA). Measure conversion and lead quality.
Omar: CTA text: Self-serve = "Try Hosted"; Sales = "Request Dedicated Eval". I'll wire CRM mapping once pipeline-bot emits events.
Ravi: Timeline: sketches today, copy tomorrow morning, A/B live by Wednesday. I'll consolidate into a PR.
